summary: NorthStrive Acquisition Corp I., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company trading on Nasdaq under NSAIU/NSAI/NSAIR/NSAIW, filed an 8-K reporting that on September 10, 2026 its board adopted routine governance policies effective September 9, 2026, following its August 2026 IPO. Items cover a Code of Conduct and Ethics, an Insider Trading Compliance Policy designating Michel Tamer as compliance officer, a Nasdaq/Section 10D clawback policy, committee charters (Compensation, Nominating/Governance, Audit) and corporate governance guidelines. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated; no special-situation event exists to arbitrage.
